headline: 5 firms get nod to launch digital banks in Bangladesh
summary: Bangladesh Bank has issued initial approvals to five institutions, marking the country's first step toward digital-only banking.
details: Bangladesh is moving toward digital-only banking as five institutions have secured letters of intent to launch their ventures.
The initial approvals were granted by the Bangladesh Bank board of directors during a meeting on Thursday.
The approved firms include bKash Digital Bank, Boost Digital Bank (backed by Robi Axiata), Kori, DK Limited, and Nova Digital Bank (backed by VEON and Square).
Bangladesh Bank spokesperson Arief Hossain Khan confirmed that these are initial licenses.
Final licenses will be issued only after the institutions fulfill all necessary conditions set by the central bank.
